start.content: It was too risky. A storm was rising faster than we could measure. I watched from the shadows. Whatever occurred there — in that house that night.

rised.content: Words. Accusations. A betrayal announced before it was complete. The teacher knew. He gave the bread to the betrayer openly. The entire room went quiet.

shadows.content: I watched from the olive grove. I had no right to be there. But when you have seen what I have seen — when a man calls the dead out of tombs and speaks to storms — you do not walk away easily.

closing.content: Say nothing of this. Some doors, once opened, do not close again.
